description: This file defines a custom UI component, RoundedTimeBar, which extends the ExoPlayer DefaultTimeBar to render a styled, rounded track with separate coloring for unplayed, buffered, and played segments. It overrides drawing to create a pill-shaped appearance and handles user scrubbing interactions.

classes.name: RoundedTimeBar
classes.description: A custom view extending DefaultTimeBar that displays a rounded, Material 3–styled track for media playback, with custom drawing logic for unplayed, buffered, and played segments.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Updates the total duration of the media and refreshes the drawing.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Updates the current playback position and refreshes the drawing.

methods.name: setBufferedPosition
methods.description: Updates the buffered position indicator and refreshes the drawing.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Custom drawing logic to render the rounded track with current buffered and played segments.
